artifact_observations.reasoning: The person's facial features are severely distorted and melted. The mouth is an unnatural dark void, and the skin texture blends into the hair without clear boundaries. The hand/fingers reaching for the bread appear fused and lack distinct digit separation, looking like a single fleshy mass.

Some of the circular patterns on top of the bread loaves look slightly painted-on or repetitive rather than naturally scored dough. The flour dusting has a uniform, spray-painted consistency in some areas.
The weave pattern of the baskets becomes inconsistent and slightly warped near the edges, losing logical geometric continuity.
